description.html: The SOBO T4 is a waterproof LED tube rated IPX8, which means it can run fully submerged. It is mounted inside the aquarium, on the back glass or under the lid, so it is also a solution for tanks with no room for a classic lamp.

The packaging lists two light versions: 6500K and 8000 to 10000K. According to the packaging, the lamp is energy-saving, bright and long-lasting. Before ordering, ask us about the light version and tube length, so the lamp fits your aquarium.

Always unplug the lamp before taking it out or moving it. Keep the plug and power unit out of the water and above the tank level, with a drip loop in the cable so water cannot run down to the socket. Switch the light on and off at the same times every day, ideally with a timer, and wipe algae and limescale off the tube from time to time.
Call us or message us on WhatsApp to order. Courier delivery across Serbia, free pickup in Novi Sad.
